story_position: Chapter 3 — Beat 7 — Ancient Barrier / First Cooperation
director_rule: Give the four Person Agents the closed-barrier situation, their own observations and expertise, the required end state, and the reveal firewall. Do not assign roles in the solution or prescribe the order in which the insight, test, release, Card look, or decision to proceed must be verbalized.

scene_context.situation: Nimera remains safely enclosed after Beat 6. The four characters now have partial observations from both sides and need to decide whether the barrier can be opened without brute force. Cyanis has modern Crest-work literacy but no Ancient expertise; Nimera has Card/archive expertise and interior observations; Torren has physical field observations; Ilyra is present with her normal risk and agency priorities.
scene_context.card_state: Cyanis carries the unclassified green-and-gold Card; it is not required as a key
scene_context.presentation: physical magical-fantasy barrier; stone, metal, engraved channels, plates, shutters and restrained magical light

hard_outcomes: The barrier is opened through cooperative reasoning and a non-destructive test rather than brute force, a password, a biometric key, or character-specific Ancient authorization.
The successful reasoning may make use of Cyanis's Crest-work literacy as an analogy, but no shared lineage or Ancient recognition is proven.
Nimera exits under her own power and remains an active collaborator rather than a rescued dependent.
Nimera gets a bounded first close look at Cyanis's Card and concludes only that it is meaningfully abnormal and worth deeper study.
The newly accessible route gives the group a reason to continue into deeper archive infrastructure.
Nimera accompanies them provisionally; permanent recruitment remains Beat 8.
Opening the route causes deeper Archive machinery to begin responding, handing into Beat 8.
knowledge_and_reveal_boundaries: No proof Cyanis has Ancient authority or permission.
No proof modern Crests derive from Diysean systems.
No Prime, Might, Last Sentinel, bearer, ownership, recovery, or deep-Ruby conclusion.
No royal-seal culprit or exact mechanism.
